item: P12 -- close P10's false-positive half (omitted parser semantics)
change: no flag -- correctness fix to chinatravel/agent/tpc_agent/parsed_verifier.py (required_order check, added; activity_time_windows now filters acts_at() by the parsed activity_types) and parse_constraints.py (parse_required_order, new)
method: hand-rolled paired before/after (git stash / git stash pop) on the same uids/budget, per P11's absence -- see README.md. Not a --mode whole-run screen (P11 does not exist on this branch); not a --flag screen (P12 has no flag).
uid_selection: the 10 (of the 51 in val whose NL matches 'dine|stay at ... between') most likely to exercise the activity_types fix -- a same-position dine+stay window pair.
result: byte-identical aggregate and per-uid official scores (schema_pass/commonsense_pass/logical_pass/overall_true all match every uid -- see baseline.json vs candidate.json). This is expected and structurally guaranteed in per-query (non-whole-run) mode: parsed_verifier.evaluate_parsed_constraints is consulted only by the final self-score (selfscore.py), not by the CP-SAT solve/accept loop that this path uses, so the produced plan is bit-identical between arms regardless of what the checker fix changes. No false positive (official=fail, self=pass) was present in this n=10 sample either before or after, so this screen demonstrates SAFETY (zero regression to the official metric, zero change to any produced plan) rather than the fix's effect size -- the roadmap item's own diagnosis put the omitted-semantics false-positive rate at 5/150 across all five categories combined, so an n=10 sample has low power to observe one. The fix's correctness and mechanism are demonstrated instead by targeted unit tests (tests/phase2/test_parsed_verifier_p12_omitted_semantics.py) built from the exact oracle DSL pattern and real released-data NL phrasing that motivated it (see that file's docstring and the PR description).

full_familiar_100_val_parser_f1.note: parser_vs_oracle --split tpc_phase2_familiar_100_val is unaffected: the two fixes are checker-side (parsed_verifier.py); the one new parser field (required_order) matched 0/80 val queries, so no family_stats entry changed.
